controls.title: Lawful basis
controls.description: A documented lawful basis exists for personal-data processing.
controls.remediation: Identify and document the applicable lawful basis before processing personal data.

controls.title: Transparency information
controls.description: Individuals receive clear information about how their personal data is processed.
controls.remediation: Provide clear, accessible privacy information covering the relevant processing.

controls.title: DPIA screening
controls.description: DPIA screening is documented and a DPIA is completed where required.
controls.remediation: Document DPIA screening and conduct a DPIA where the processing is likely to result in high risk.

controls.title: AI risk management
controls.description: A documented and iterative risk-management process exists.
controls.remediation: Establish and maintain a documented AI risk-management process.

controls.title: Human oversight
controls.description: Effective human-oversight measures exist for relevant AI use.
controls.remediation: Define human-oversight responsibilities, intervention rights, and override procedures.

controls.title: AI transparency
controls.description: Applicable transparency obligations are identified and implemented.
controls.remediation: Implement the transparency and disclosure measures applicable to the AI use case.
